nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes: responseMode=lastNode: the HTTP 200 is sent only after the file is written, so the device's success check means something.

nodes.name: Build note
nodes.notes: Handles all three payload types in one node — the branches differ only in folder, title and body, so a Switch would just pick between near-identical copies.

nodes.name: Write to vault
nodes.notes: Native file node — no require('fs'), so NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN is not needed. Does NOT create missing directories: notes/, meetings/ and test/ must exist. If n8n runs in Docker this path must be a mounted volume.
